name: Dataset profile
summary: Before anyone joins or relies on a new export, the analyst gets one profile of it: what one row stands for, where keys repeat, what is missing, which values look odd, and a numbered list of questions for the data owner. No data is changed and no verdict is given.

sources.title: Profiling one supplied extract against its schema notes: the header check that stops on a mismatch, the claimed row grain tested against the data, duplicates split into identical rows and repeated keys with different values, blanks kept apart from placeholder text, formats and look-alike values, the far-out rule, the consistency rules the person lists, a note of what the findings touch for the intended use, questions for the data owner, and the rule that no row is changed, removed or judged, written for this template.
